records.mechanism: A fixed-supply token launch with directional transfer fees, beneficiary-owned ETH rewards, optional initial-buy custody, and permanently locked Uniswap v4 liquidity.
records.name: Classic
outcomes: Launch a fixed-supply token with visible buy and sell fees.
Route creator rewards to beneficiary-controlled claim vaults.
Keep the launch liquidity position permanently locked.
records.summary: A fixed-supply token with independent buy and sell fees, beneficiary-owned ETH rewards, optional initial-buy custody, and permanently locked Uniswap v4 liquidity.

records.mechanism: A proposed launch design that directs creator-side fee revenue into add-only locked liquidity until an immutable target is reached.
records.name: Deep
outcomes: Convert creator-side revenue into additional locked liquidity.
Stop the deepening phase at an immutable target.
Keep liquidity additions non-withdrawable under the proposed design.
records.summary: A proposed launch model that directs the creator fee share into add-only locked liquidity until an immutable target is reached.

records.mechanism: A fixed-supply token paired with one reviewed tokenized stock or ETF quote asset, with quote-asset rewards and locked launch liquidity.
records.name: Stock-Paired
outcomes: Launch against a reviewed tokenized stock or ETF quote asset.
Pay creator-side rewards in the quote asset.
Preserve a permanently locked launch-liquidity design.
records.summary: A fixed-supply token paired with one reviewed tokenized stock or ETF quote asset, with quote-asset rewards and permanently locked Uniswap v4 launch liquidity.
